headline: Anglo American Brazil head calls for stable critical-minerals framework
summary: Anglo American's Brazil head, Ana Sanches, urged the country to establish clear rules for critical-minerals investments as Brasilia balances commercial relationships between China and the US.
why: Anglo American is a major global diversified miner; Brazil holds strategic reserves of critical minerals necessary for energy transition and high-tech supply chains.

impacts.name: Mining
impacts.why: Investment decisions depend on the regulatory clarity Brasilia delivers for extraction and export deals.
